Early humans spread out.note: Reviewer: 'Manusia purba' is how Indonesian schools name archaic humans (Pithecanthropus, Homo erectus); the picture is about our own species spreading out of Africa. Consistent with the L05 lesson text, so decide course-wide (e.g. 'manusia awal' / 'manusia zaman dulu').
